description:
Get all inscriptions owned by a Bitcoin address. Returns inscription IDs, content types, and metadata. Backed by the Unisat indexer; set UNISAT_API_KEY to lift free-tier rate limits.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Bitcoin address to check. Uses wallet's Bitcoin address if not provided.

name: get_inscriptions_by_address
